title: Indonesia’s illegal mining crackdown facing structural hurdles, BMI says
body: Indonesia’s plans to seize more than 1,000 illegal mining sites starting this month are unlikely to deliver "meaningful environmental gains", the Fitch Solutions company says.

title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina
body: South32 reported a 75% surge in full-year profit on Thursday, helped by strong performance at its alumina division and higher commodity prices.

title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September
body: Freeport expects to complete early next month repair work at its JV smelter in East Java.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: Nickel surpasses coal as Indonesia’s top export, Macquarie says
body: Earnings from overseas sales of nickel products were $16.5 billion in the first half of the year.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel Industry with Strategic Management and Increased Production
body: Indonesia has the potential to become a major player in the global nickel industry, with over 700 million tons of nickel reserves and 54 smelter facilities, and is expected to produce 414,000 tons of nickel this year. However, the industry faces challenges such as reliance on imports and high production costs, and the government is urged to provide strategic solutions to maintain competitive pricing and support the growth of the domestic industry.

title: Indonesian Government Evaluates B40 Biodiesel Program Implementation with Mining Industry Stakeholders
body: The Indonesian government, through the Directorate General of New, Renewable, and Energy Conservation, held a discussion on the implementation of the 40% biodiesel program in the industrial sector, which has increased production costs in the nickel mining sector by 3-5%. The evaluation aims to find solutions to ensure the program's sustainability, considering factors such as global commodity prices and the potential impact of the upcoming B50 program.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Industry Faces Challenges with B40 Implementation and Decreasing Nickel Prices
body: The Indonesian nickel mining industry is experiencing significant challenges due to the implementation of B40, with production costs increasing by 3-5% and nickel prices reaching a 10-year low of $15,000 per metric ton. The industry is calling for a comprehensive evaluation of the B40 policy before implementing B50 next year, citing concerns over supply chain disruptions, decreased profit margins, and reduced tax revenues.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Releases Nickel Price Reference for September 2025
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) has announced a decrease in the Nickel Price Reference (HMA) for September 2025, with a price of US$ 14.899,64 per dry metric ton, down from US$ 15.012,67 per dmt in the previous period. The association also provided detailed pricing for nickel ore with varying moisture content and nickel grades, ranging from US$ 28.37 to US$ 43.80 per wet metric ton.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index (INPI) reported stable global nickel prices, with Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (MHP) experiencing a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton. The price stability and MHP increase reflect a balance between global supply and demand, as well as growing demand for nickel-based battery industry products, particularly in the Asian market.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Industry Faces Trilemma in Implementing Environment, Social and Governance Standards
body: Indonesia's nickel industry is expected to face a trilemma of global demand, community price, and Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) standards, with the implementation of ESG standards predicted to increase costs, but potentially leading to a win-win situation for all stakeholders. The industry's largest producers, such as Vale, have already implemented ESG standards, achieving low emission levels, including an intensity of 28.7 tons CO2 per ton of nickel, but the market for green nickel remains underdeveloped.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Sector Faces Challenges from Illegal Mining and Environmental Concerns
body: The Indonesian nickel mining sector is struggling with the issue of illegal mining, which is hindering the implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles and causing environmental damage and social unrest. The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) is working to address these issues and promote a more sustainable and responsible mining industry, including the development of a roadmap for decarbonization and the involvement of stakeholders such as local communities and NGOs.

title: Pertamina New & Renewable Energy strengthens its position in the global energy transition with a 14% increase in renewable energy capacity to 2,842 MW in the first semester of 2025.
body: Pertamina NRE's renewable energy capacity has increased by 14% to 2,842 MW in the first semester of 2025, driven by the acquisition of a 20% stake in Citicore Renewable Energy Corporation, which reported a 28% increase in revenue and a 38% increase in net profit. The company aims to expand its renewable energy capacity to 5 GW in the next five years, with a target of 1 GW in the first year, and is committed to supporting the global energy transition and reducing carbon emissions.

title: Nilai Ekonomi Karbon membuka peluang ekonomi baru dan meningkatkan efisiensi energi di Indonesia
body: Penerapan Nilai Ekonomi Karbon (NEK) di Indonesia dapat membantu pencapaian target iklim, meningkatkan efisiensi energi, dan mendorong adopsi teknologi rendah karbon, serta membuka peluang ekonomi baru melalui pasar kredit karbon dan penguatan daya saing industri. Dengan demikian, Indonesia dapat mempersiapkan diri menghadapi kebijakan internasional seperti Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) dan meningkatkan ketahanan ekonomi rumah tangga terhadap fluktuasi harga energi di masa depan.

title: Kilang Pertamina Internasional Exceeds Operational Targets in First Semester 2025
body: Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) has surpassed its operational targets for the first semester of 2025, processing approximately 159 million barrels of crude oil and achieving an 84% yield of valuable products. The company has also reduced its cumulative emissions by 205,000 tons of CO2 equivalent, exceeding its initial target of 157,000 tons, and has improved its energy efficiency with an Energy Intensity Index (EII) of 105, lower than its target of 107.

title: Indonesia's Energy Policy Requires Consistency and Long-Term Planning to Avoid Crisis
body: Indonesia's energy policy has been criticized for being inconsistent and driven by political motives, leading to a lack of investment in renewable energy and a reliance on imported fuels. The country needs to adopt a long-term approach to energy planning, prioritizing sustainability and consistency to avoid crises and ensure a stable economic future.
